title: AI Ads & Creatives Editor
description:
We're looking for a creative, AI-savvy producer to make scroll-stopping video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram). You'll use AI tools to turn briefs and ideas into finished ads — fast.



You'll be supported on creative strategy: briefs, hooks, and angles will be developed with you. Your job is to bring them to life through prompting, AI video generation, and editing — and to keep getting better at it.



This is a hands-on production role. We need someone who prompts like a pro, edits like a creator, and ships ads quickly.



What You'll Do:

- Produce AI-generated videos using Higgsfield (and similar tools) — characters, scenes, motion, voice overs.

- Write structured prompts in Claude to generate scripts, hooks, ad copy, and creative variations.

- Edit and polish ads in CapCut: cuts, captions, transitions, sound design, branding.

- Research winning ads using spy tools (TrendTrack, BrandSearch, or similar) to find references, hooks, and angles to adapt.

- Iterate fast. Ship multiple variations per brief, learn from what performs, and apply it to the next batch.

- Stay current on new AI creative tools and bring fresh techniques to the team.



Don't worry — you won't be doing strategy alone. We'll work with you on briefs, hooks, and angles. Over time, as you grow into the role, you'll have more input on creative direction.



What We're Looking For:

- Hands-on experience with Claude for advanced prompting — structured prompts that produce reliable, high-quality outputs.

- Working knowledge of Higgsfield or similar AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Sora, etc.).

- Proficiency in CapCut for fast, high-quality video editing.

- Familiarity with Meta Ads creative formats and what makes them work (hooks, pacing, UGC style, direct-response basics).

- Experience with at least one ad spy tool is a plus (TrendTrack, BrandSearch, Foreplay, Minea, or similar).

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Reliable internet, a capable computer, and a quiet workspace.



Nice to Have:

- A portfolio of ads that have run on Meta with measurable results.

- Experience with DTC, e-commerce, or info-product brands.

- Familiarity with ElevenLabs, or other supporting AI tools.



What We Offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote position.

- Compensation aligned with your profile and experience.

- Creative strategy support — you won't be working in a vacuum.

- A creative environment where AI tools are encouraged and expected.

- Room to grow as the team scales.



How to Apply:

Send us:

1. Your resume / CV.

2. A portfolio of ad creatives you've produced — videos, links to live ads, or case studies.

3. A short note answering: Which AI tools do you use most, and what you use each one for?



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Influencer Marketing Specialist to manage our influencer outreach end-to-end on a rolling basis. You will scout, contact, negotiate, and coordinate collaborations with micro and mid-tier influencers across our target markets, and make sure clothing packages are sent out and content is delivered on time.



We want someone who thinks outside the box, a person who takes the time to deeply understand our brand, our aesthetic, and our positioning, and uses that understanding to identify creators and angles we wouldn't think of ourselves. We are not looking for someone who just executes a checklist; we want a strategic partner who brings ideas to the table.



Key Responsibilities

---

Scouting & Research

- Identify new potential influencers on Instagram and TikTok matching our aesthetic and brand positioning.

- Vet profiles based on engagement rate, audience demographics, content quality, and brand fit.

- Maintain a clean influencer database with contact info, follower count, engagement rate, niche, and status.



Outreach & Negotiation

- Send personalized DMs and
s to potential influencers.

- Pitch our collaboration model and negotiate deliverables (number of stories, reels, posts) and timelines.

- Follow up consistently with prospects in the pipeline.



Coordination & Logistics

- Collect sizing, address, and product preferences from confirmed collaborations.

- Place internal orders and coordinate with our fulfillment team to ship clothing sets.

- Track packages and make sure influencers receive products in time.



Content & Reporting

- Make sure agreed deliverables are posted on time, with correct tags, hashtags, and affiliate links.

- Collect, save, and organize all UGC content in a shared Drive folder for paid ads and organic use.

- Weekly report on: new outreach, confirmed collabs, sent packages, posted content, and generated sales via affiliate links.



---



Requirements

- Proven experience in influencer marketing (this is a must, please share specific examples of past campaigns or brands you've worked with).

- Strategic thinker who takes initiative to deeply understand the brand and propose creative angles, not just execute briefs.

- Fluent English (written and spoken).

- Strong eye for aesthetic and brand fit, you understand the difference between "elegant" and "fast fashion."

- Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage a large pipeline of contacts simultaneously.

- Comfortable with Instagram, TikTok, Google Sheets, Shopify, and basic
/DM templates.

- Proactive communicator, does not need to be micromanaged.

We are looking for a Brand & Content Strategist who will plan every piece of content we shoot, direct the person executing on the ground in Portugal, and build the Instagram presence that becomes the engine of this brand.

This is a remote, part-time role (20–25 hours per week). You will not touch a camera. You will think, research, direct, and write briefs.

Study what is working right now on Instagram for brands in our world — menswear, old money, classic European style, cinematic lifestyle content. Identify trends we should replicate.

Spot viral formats from other brands and adapt them to MECENAS aesthetic.

You have a trained eye for Western fashion and old money aesthetics. You can instantly tell the difference between "old money" and "flashy luxury." You know why a vintage Porsche is on-brand for us and a new Range Rover is not.

You are obsessed with Instagram. You know what is performing this month, not last year.

Your English is strong in writing. Spoken English is a plus but not critical.

 @marvinbrooks

/message containing all five of the following:

description:
Part-Time | Remote | Fixed + Bonus Pay



---



WHAT WE DO



We run a men’s fashion brand called MECENAS. Our target customer is an ambitious man aged 21–30 who is into old money style, surfing, classic cars, stoic philosophy, and living well. 



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your only job is to post 2 Reels per day on our Instagram.



To do this, you will:



1. Search TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube for videos that are already viral and match our brand vibe

2. Re-use that footage or remix it slightly to fit our brand

3. Add our brand’s philosophy text, quotes, or voiceovers when needed

4. Also use footage from our own brand photoshoots (we will provide these)

5. Post 2 finished Reels every single day



You do NOT need to film anything yourself. You do NOT need to create everything from scratch. Most of the time you are finding content that already went viral for someone else and adapting it slightly for us.



---



WHAT KINDS OF VIDEOS TO MAKE



All videos must feel relevant to this type of man:



- Clips from movies like Peaky Blinders, American Psycho, The Godfather, James Bond

- Lifestyle content: classic cars, surfing, nice watches, coffee, suits, travel

- Motivational or stoic quotes with cinematic backgrounds

- Voiceover videos about discipline, ambition, success, style

- Men’s fashion and style clips

- Any viral content that a stylish, ambitious 25-year-old man would stop and watch



IMPORTANT: Do not post content about gym motivation, nightclubs, flashy cars, loud music, or anything that looks cheap or loud. Our brand is quiet, elegant, and classy.



---



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- You have experience creating or repurposing Reels or TikTok videos

- You know how to use CapCut or similar editing app

- You understand what makes a video go viral

- You are consistent and reliable — 2 posts per day, every day, no excuses

- You have good English for captions and text overlays

- You understand men’s lifestyle content (not required to be an expert, but needs to “get it”)



---



PAY



- Fixed base pay every month (discuss in application)

- Bonus payment for every Reel that reaches over 100,000 views

- The more videos go viral, the more you earn



---



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:

1. 3 examples of Reels or TikToks you have made or remixed (links are fine)

2. One sentence explaining why you understand our brand audience

3. Confirm you can post 2 Reels per day consistently



Applications without examples will not be considered.

title: Closers ( High Commission )
description:
Job Title: Sales Closer — Crypto Mining (100% Commission)

Company: [CryptoMine / your brand]

We're a crypto mining operation handling ASIC sales, hosting, repairs, and turnkey infrastructure for clients across MENA, North America, LatAm, and Asia. Deal sizes run from $20k to $500k+. Our top accounts are HNWIs, family offices, and institutional miners. We've built the pipeline. We need a closer who can convert it.

The Role

You take qualified meetings booked by our SDR team and close them. That's it. No prospecting, no list-building, no admin — we want you on calls. Discovery ? proposal ? close. You'll handle warm inbound (referrals, paid traffic) and SDR-booked meetings.

The Comp



100% commission. No base.

[10–15]% of gross profit on hardware sales

[15–20]% of first-year revenue on hosting contracts

5% recurring on hosting MRR for 12 months after close

Bonuses for blowout months and multi-six-figure deals



OTE for a serious closer: $10k–$30k+/month. Top performer last year cleared $358k. We don't cap. If you're closing $1M/mo, you're getting paid like it.

Paid weekly. Crypto or fiat. Your call.

What You'll Do



Run 15–25 qualified calls per week (we keep your calendar full)

Discovery, qualification, pricing, proposal, close

Handle objections with technical fluency — buyers will quiz you on hashrate, profitability curves, hosting economics, repair logistics

Own the deal from first call to wire confirmation

Work with ops to coordinate fulfillment after close

Log everything in CRM. We measure: meetings ? proposals ? closes ? ACV

Feedback the pipeline: which leads are converting, which aren't, why



You're a Fit If You



Have 3+ years closing high-ticket B2B (crypto, hardware, infrastructure, fintech, real estate, energy — adjacent industries are fine if the deal sizes match)

Have closed deals north of $50k and aren't intimidated by $250k+ tickets

Live in crypto. You hold it, trade it, or work in it. You can explain hashprice, breakeven, halving impact, and hosting margins in plain English to a banker.

Know mining hardware — at minimum the Bitmain S19/S21 series and the WhatsMiner M50/M60 lines. Hashrate, watts/TH, immersion vs air, all native vocab.

Are calm on six-figure calls. No happy ears. You qualify hard and don't chase.

Self-managed. Track your own pipeline. Hit your own numbers. We don't babysit.

Have a quiet office, good internet, and a working camera. Mining buyers expect a professional on the other end of Zoom.



Bonus



Existing network in mining, crypto VC, family offices, or institutional desks

Spoken Arabic, Mandarin, Russian, Spanish, or Portuguese

Experience selling colocation, hosting, or data center capacity

Have personally bought or operated miners



Auto-Disqualifies



"I'm new to crypto but I learn fast" — not this role

Pure SaaS background with no hardware or high-ticket experience

Need a base salary — we don't offer one. By design.



How to Apply

Send a Loom (5 min max) covering:



Walk me through the biggest deal you've closed — deal size, sales cycle, how it almost died, how you saved it

A buyer says: "I can get S21s for $1,200/unit from China. Why would I pay you $1,650?" — respond as if it's a live call

What's your current monthly closed revenue, and why are you looking?



Plus: 3 references from past sales managers or commission statements (we'll verify).

Subject line: "Closer — [your name] — [largest single deal you've closed]"

Example: "Closer — Mike Chen — $340k"

Applications without a Loom or with a vague subject line get auto-deleted.

We are a better-for-you food company focused on clean-label sauces, condiments, and pantry staples made with wholesome ingredients and globally inspired flavors. description:
Finance Manager (UK Accounting Experience Required)

Company: Zest Media Group

Location: Remote

Role Type: Part-time, flexible hours (TBC)

Reports to: Managing Director / Senior Leadership



About Zest Media

Zest Media is a dynamic digital media and publishing company producing premium magazines and marketing solutions across multiple platforms. As a remote-first organisation, we value accuracy, accountability, and operational excellence across all departments.



We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Manager to oversee the company’s financial operations, including ledgers, management accounts, budgeting, VAT, payroll, and year-end processes.

The role also includes responsibility for financial processing for our property portfolio, Shaltout Properties Ltd, a related company.



The Role

We are hiring an experienced overseas Finance Manager to support the financial operations of a UK-based business. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience with UK accounting practices, compliance requirements, payroll processing, VAT, and financial reporting.



This role requires someone who understands UK accounting standards and can independently manage the core financial disciplines required to operate a UK company efficiently and compliantly.



Essential Requirements

Proven experience working with UK-based companies.

Strong understanding of UK accounting standards and compliance.

Hands-on experience with:

VAT returns

PAYE

UK payroll processing

HMRC submissions

Management accounts

Bank reconciliations

Financial reporting

Experience using UK accounting software (Sage).

Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Comfortable working remotely with an overseas team setup.



Preferred Qualifications

ACCA, ACA, CIMA, AAT, or equivalent accounting qualification.

Experience working with SMEs or media/marketing businesses.

Experience managing multi-company accounts.

Knowledge of UK corporation tax basics.



Key Responsibilities

UK Accounting & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate financial records in line with UK accounting standards.

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliation processes.

Prepare monthly management accounts and financial reports.

Monitor cash flow, expenses, and company financial performance.

Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable.

VAT & HMRC Compliance

Prepare and submit VAT returns accurately and on time.

Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations.

Understand Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements.

Maintain proper records for audits and tax submissions.

Payroll & PAYE

Process UK payroll accurately and on schedule.

Manage PAYE, National Insurance contributions, pensions, and statutory payments.

Handle payroll reporting requirements and submissions to HMRC.

Ensure compliance with UK employment and payroll regulations.

Financial Reporting

Prepare profit & loss reports, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

Assist with budgeting and forecasting.

Support year-end accounts preparation.

Work alongside external accountants where required.

Systems & Process Management

Use accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or similar.

Improve financial systems and reporting processes.

Maintain organised digital financial records and documentation.





Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone reliable, proactive, and highly organised who can take ownership of the company’s finance operations. The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing the day-to-day accounting responsibilities of a UK business without requiring constant supervision.

title: Content Editor for Social Media & Meta Ads – Geurwolkje
description:
Content Editor for Social Media & Meta Ads – Geurwolkje



Company: Geurwolkje

Job Type: Freelance / Remote

Language: English required, Dutch is a plus



About Geurwolkje



Geurwolkje is a fast-growing aromatherapy brand focused on premium diffusers, pure essential oils, and natural wellness products. We create products that help people bring more calm, warmth, and balance into their home and daily routine.



Our brand is visual, emotional, clean, and conversion-driven. We are active on social media and run Meta ads at scale. We are now looking for a sharp Content Editor who can help us turn raw ideas, footage, and creative concepts into powerful content for both organic social media and paid Meta campaigns.



What We Need



We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

• content that builds brand love

• content that grabs attention fast

• content that performs in paid ads

• content that feels native to social platforms



You will help us edit and refine content for:

• Instagram Reels

• TikTok videos

• Meta Ads 
 & Instagram)

• UGC-style ad creatives

• Story-based short-form content

• Product-focused promotional videos

• Lifestyle and aesthetic brand content



Your Role



You will be responsible for editing and optimizing content in a way that matches the Geurwolkje brand and improves performance.



Your tasks include:

• Editing short-form videos for social media and Meta ads

• Turning raw footage into scroll-stopping content

• Creating multiple variations of the same creative for testing

• Adding captions, hooks, pacing, structure, and flow

• Improving ad creatives based on performance feedback

• Making content feel native to TikTok, Instagram, and

• Working with our team on concepts, briefs, and revisions

• Keeping a strong eye on brand consistency, aesthetics, and conversion



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who is not just a video editor, but someone who understands marketing, performance, and attention.



You should have:

• Proven experience editing content for social media and Meta ads

• Strong understanding of hook rate, retention, pacing, and conversion

• Experience with UGC-style editing

• A good eye for luxury, wellness, lifestyle, and aesthetic branding

• Ability to make content feel emotional, natural, and high-converting

• Strong communication and reliability

• Fast turnaround and ability to work with feedback



Big plus if you have experience with:

• E-commerce brands

• Wellness, beauty, home, or lifestyle products

• Direct response ad creatives

• Testing different ad angles and hooks

• Working with creative strategists or media buyers



Style We Like



Our brand is calm, premium, sensory, natural, and warm.



We do not want generic content.



We want content that feels:

• elegant

• emotional

• native

• clean

• visually strong

• performance-driven



You need to understand both branding and selling.



Deliverables



Depending on the project, deliverables may include:

• 15–60 second edited videos

• multiple hook variations

• ad creative cutdowns

• social-first organic edits

• subtitle/caption integration

• format adaptations for different platforms



To Apply



Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of social media content you edited

3. Examples of Meta ad creatives you edited

4. Which brands or niches you worked with before

5. Your rate and availability

6. Your favorite short-form ad or brand creative you’ve seen recently, and why it works



Important



We are looking for someone with a real feel for high-performing creative, not just someone who can make videos look nice.



You must understand how to edit for:

• attention

• emotion

• retention

• conversion



If you know how to make content that people actually stop and watch, we want to hear from you.

title: Social Media Editor & Content Publisher
description:
We believe people suffer because they're misaligned — with their biology, their purpose, and the systems they live inside. 



Our work is about changing that.



This is a U.S.-based psychiatric practice led by an Ivy League-trained female physician specializing in women's mental health, hormonal health, and complex diagnostic care. We help women understand their own design and align with the highest version of themselves — biologically, psychologically, and spiritually. 



The practice is supported by an all-women operations team.



We are building a brand that carries this mission to a much larger audience — through content that educates, positions, and converts. Not influencer content. Not wellness content. Physician-led authority content that helps the right people find us and arrive ready to commit.



We need the person who will own that brand's content presence. Someone who believes in this mission enough to protect it.



How we work:

The founder directs the vision. AI scaffolds our thinking — generating drafts, analyzing trends, multiplying content across platforms. Nobody here stops thinking. Your role is to execute with judgment, taste, and precision. You take AI-generated output and the founder's original material, refine it to meet the brand standard, and make sure it reaches the right audience on the right platform at the right time.

You are not replaced by AI. You manage AI. As tools evolve, you adopt them, integrate them into the workflow, and remain the human quality gate that ensures nothing goes live that doesn't serve the mission.



Nice to Have:

— C1/C2 English (written and verbal) — non-negotiable

— 3+ years in content production and brand building — professional services, luxury, health, or thought leadership preferred. E-commerce alone does not qualify. If you've done this work but your title didn't reflect it, we still want to hear from you.

— Fluency across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and a newsletter platform (Substack preferred)

—
 marketing experience — automated sequences, audience segmentation, conversion-focused strategy

— Video editing proficiency (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut)

— AI content and video tool experience (OpusClip, Vizard, Descript, HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Canva AI, or similar)

— Strong Canva or Figma skills

— SEO and discoverability knowledge — YouTube optimization, keyword strategy

— Portfolio showing premium, restrained brand work — clean and authoritative, not flashy

— Central Time hours (Mon–Fri, 8 AM–5 PM CT)

----Podcast production, motion graphics.



Compensation: $1,400–$1,600/month based on experience. Long-term position. Leadership-track role that grows into Director of Content & Brand as the practice scales toward book publication, a national podcast, and speaking engagements. The brand you build here becomes your signature work.

Hiring process: Selected candidates begin with a paid trial period before moving into the full role.



To apply, send ALL of the following:

1) Portfolio — live account links to feeds you manage or have managed preferred. If not available, send a comprehensive portfolio showing actual content you've created across platforms.

2) Resume.

Campaign Building

Maintain clean and structured campaign architecture (no duplication, misconfigurations, or orphaned assets)

Ensure pixel tracking and UTM parameters are correctly implemented on all campaigns

Enforce strict naming conventions across all builds

Provide regular updates or summaries to the Senior Marketing Manager via Slack 



Other Responsibilities

Contribute to maintaining a structured, efficient, and high-performing ad account environment

Minimum of 3 years’ hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager on a daily basis

Deep understanding of campaign setup, including objectives, audiences, placements, and budget optimisation

Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy, naming conventions, and tracking setup

Comfortable working as an execution-focused tea
mber, following clear direction

Highly Preferred:

title: AI-Native Creative Strategist
description:

**Company:** MARTHA AI

**Type:** Part-Time or Full-Time | Long-Term Contract

---



## About MARTHA AI



MARTHA AI is an AI-native paid social company based in San Francisco, CA. We build and manage performance advertising campaigns for e-commerce brands on Meta and TikTok — from strategy all the way through creative and optimization.



Our clients are scaling fast. We need a reliable, creative, and self-directed specialist who can produce high-quality ad creatives consistently, week over week.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.



---



## What You'll Be Doing



You'll receive creative briefs (via Loom video) with reference ads and brand assets already provided. Your job is to take that input and produce clean, on-brand ad creatives ready to run.



Creative formats include:



- Static image ads (single image and carousel)

- Short-form video editing

- UGC-style video ads

- Lifestyle content

- Remixing and rebranding top-performing existing ads



Volume runs 20–50 creatives per week per client, scaling to 100–200+ per month depending on your capacity and output quality.



---



## Who We're Looking For



You don't need a degree or formal credentials. We hire based on output.



**Required:**

- Experience making paid social ads for e-commerce brands (Meta or TikTok)

- Ability to study a reference ad and produce a fresh version that matches the brief

- Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

- Detail-oriented, fast, and able to deliver clean work the first time

- Comfortable working fully async — no scheduled calls, communication via Loom and Slack



**Bonus:**

- Experience with AI tools in your creative workflow (Higgsfield AI, ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, etc.)

- Background in e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands

- Experience with motion graphics or static design (Canva, Photoshop, Figma)



---



## How It Works



- You receive a Loom brief with references, brand assets, and clear direction

- You execute and deliver completed creatives

- Approved creatives are paid at **$20–$50 per creative**

- All communication is async — Loom for briefs, Slack for quick updates

- No time tracking. No micromanagement. We care about output.



For the right person, this is consistent, ongoing work.



---



## How to Apply



**Do not apply with just a resume.** We review portfolios and test edits only.



1. Send a message with the subject: **Creative Specialist – [Your Name]**

2. Include 2–3 examples of paid social ads you've made for e-commerce brands (video preferred)

3. List the tools you use (editing software, AI tools, design tools)

Only applicants who complete the test edit will move forward. This is how we hire.

title: Senior Accountant /Finance Lead - NIGHT SHIFT
description:
Position Type: Full Time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: M–F, 8 AM – 5 PM EST for initial 60 days; shift overlap reassessment to follow.



About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing, service-based business operating in a dynamic, high-performance environment. They manage multiple revenue streams, including recurring retainers and variable performance-based billing, and prioritize financial accuracy, operational discipline, and data-driven decision-making. The company maintains a lean structure where finance plays a critical role in guiding strategic growth, ensuring audit-ready books, and supporting leadership with timely, actionable insights.



About the Role:



This is a high-impact, hybrid Senior Accountant / Finance Lead position designed for a professional who excels at both meticulous execution and strategic thinking. You will serve as the company’s financial backbone, maintaining total ownership of the accounting lifecycle—from day-to-day bookkeeping to orchestrating a seamless month-end close.



Beyond the numbers, you will act as a strategic partner to the CEO, translating financial data into actionable insights, forecasts, and models that drive growth. This is not a passive reporting role. You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively flagging risks, surfacing trends, and ensuring our financial systems are clean, accurate, and built to scale alongside a fast-growing business.



Responsibilities:

Core Accounting & Close

Own end-to-end bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

Perform weekly reconciliations (bank, credit cards)

Deliver clean monthly close by the 5th business day

Maintain audit-ready financial records and documentation

Revenue & Expense Management

Handle accrual-based revenue recognition across multiple billing models

Manage receipt capture and expense substantiation (Dext)

Maintain and evolve the chart of accounts

Fixed Assets & Compliance

Manage fixed asset register, depreciation, and loan amortization

Execute accountable plan reimbursements with proper documentation

Maintain operational tax compliance (state, sales tax, nexus setup)

Payroll & Payables

Own payroll across systems (Rippling, Payoneer)

Manage accounts payable workflows, approvals, and vendor setup

Ensure accurate 1099 preparation and compliance

Accounts Receivable

Monitor collections and Stripe autopay health

Own AR follow-ups, payment plans, and escalation

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Prepare monthly reporting package (P&L, cash flow, AR aging, unit economics)

Own budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling

Conduct profitability and scenario analysis

Strategic Finance

Partner with CEO on financial insights and decision-making

Identify risks, inefficiencies, and margin leakage proactively

Systems & Controls

Own and optimize the financial tech stack

Design and maintain internal controls and SOPs

Ensure systems, automations, and integrations remain accurate and scalable



Competencies and Qualifications:



Must-Haves

Strong US GAAP accounting knowledge (accrual-based)

Advanced QuickBooks Online expertise

Deep experience with month-end close and reconciliations

Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (financial modeling)

Payroll management experience (Rippling or similar)

Revenue recognition experience (multi-structure billing)

High attention to detail with audit-level documentation standards

Professional-level verbal and written English skills are required. You must be able to explain complex financial data clearly to non-finance leadership and maintain high responsiveness via Slack and
.



Nice-to-Haves

QBO ProAdvisor Certification

Experience with tools like Helcim, Dext, Melio, Payoneer, PandaDoc

Familiarity with tax strategies like the Augusta Rule, Section 179 and bonus depreciation execution

Experience in service-based or agency environments

Internal controls design experience

Multi-entity accounting experience



Key Qualities:

Organized: Maintains a systematic approach to data, deadlines, and SOP management.

Decisive: Acts with conviction and provides clear, data-backed recommendations to leadership.

Analytical: Translates complex financial data into actionable trends and growth insights.

Inquisitive: Digs deep into the "why" to solve problems and optimize systems.

Detail-Oriented: Maintains an "audit-ready" mindset with flawless accuracy in every entry.



What This Role Does Not Own:

title: Practice Operations Virtual Assistant ~ Australian Allied Health Private Practice (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
A telehealth-based allied health private practice in Melbourne, Australia is looking for a reliable, warm, and detail-oriented virtual assistant and executive assistant to support both the operational side of the business and the founder personally on a long-term basis. The practice specialises in neuroaffirmative therapy and is led by a solo neurodivergent (AuDHD) founder who values clear communication, patience, and genuine kindness in a working relationship.



This is a part-time role (15 to 20 hours per week) working directly with the founder. The ideal candidate is someone who takes genuine ownership of their work, communicates with kindness and professionalism, and is comfortable learning new systems quickly. If you are the kind of person who anticipates what needs to be done before being asked, and who treats other people's business like it matters to them personally, this role is for you.



Understanding of or willingness to learn about neurodivergent communication styles is a real plus. The founder communicates in a direct, stream-of-consciousness way and sometimes needs information presented back in structured, organised formats. 



Patience, flexibility, and the ability to work with someone whose brain moves fast and juggles many priorities at once will make this partnership thrive.



WHAT THE ROLE INVOLVES:



Practice Operations:



The virtual assistant will be responsible for managing and triaging the practice inbox, drafting and sending professional
s on behalf of the founder using Google Workspace. They will process invoices and billing through the practice management system, follow up with plan managers, and track payments. Revenue tracking is a core responsibility, including monitoring incoming payments, flagging overdue invoices, and keeping the founder informed on the financial health of the practice week to week.



Calendar management is a key part of the role, including scheduling client sessions, blocking admin time, and coordinating care tea
etings via Google Calendar. The role also involves client waitlist outreach, which includes contacting prospective clients, confirming their interest, and booking intake calls.



Phone management is required. The virtual assistant will handle incoming calls to the practice, respond to voi
s, return missed calls, and make outbound calls on behalf of the founder when needed, including following up with clients, providers, and organisations. A professional, warm phone manner and clear spoken English are essential.



The virtual assistant will also be responsible for outreach activities, including reaching out to potential referral sources, following up on networking opportunities, contacting organisations about collaboration or speaking engagements, and any other relationship-building communications the founder needs support with.



On top of this, the role includes basic design work in Canva using existing brand templates, website updates, assisting with conference registrations and professional directory listings, light bookkeeping support, and keeping track of tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups using Anytype (a knowledge and task management platform), ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. 



Executive Assistant to the Founder:

Beyond practice operations, this role also functions as a personal executive assistant to the founder. The founder runs a growing business and needs someone who can act as an extension of her brain. This means being the person who reminds her of upcoming deadlines, flags things she might have forgotten, keeps her on track with priorities, and proactively manages her schedule so she can focus on clinical work and strategic growth.



The founder will regularly delegate tasks directly, things like "can you research this for me," "can you draft this
," "can you register me for this event," "can you follow up with this person," "can you set up this meeting." 



The right candidate will be comfortable receiving ad hoc instructions, clarifying anything unclear, and executing with minimal hand-holding. They will treat the founder's time as a resource in the business and actively protect it.



What the Founder is Looking For

Excellent written and spoken English is essential. The virtual assistant will be corresponding with and calling Australian clients, healthcare professionals, and government-funded organisations, so all communication must be professional, warm, and natural-sounding. Experience as a VA, executive assistant, or operations assistant is required. 



The candidate must be comfortable learning and working across multiple platforms. The core tools used in the practice are Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), Anytype, Canva, and Xero. (Also please put this word in your application to know you actually read this in detail, Spongebob) 



Above all, the founder is looking for someone who is kind, respectful, and emotionally mature. This is a small, values-driven practice and the working relationship is close and collaborative. The right person for this role is someone who communicates openly when they are unsure, asks questions rather than guessing, handles feedback with grace, and brings a positive and solutions-oriented attitude to their work every day. title: Senior Video Editor/Content Planner
description:
Job Title: Senior Video Editor / Content Planner



Reports To: Creative Manager

The Senior Video Editor / Content Planner is responsible for leading the planning, production, and editing of high-quality video content for digital platforms, marketing campaigns, branding initiatives, and social media channels. This role combines advanced video editing expertise with strategic content planning to create compelling visual storytelling that aligns with brand objectives and audience engagement goals.



The ideal candidate is highly creative, detail-oriented, and experienced in managing video projects from concept development through final delivery. They should have a strong understanding of content strategy, production workflows, storytelling, and current digital media trends.





 Key Responsibilities / Duties



 Video Editing & Production



 Edit and produce high-quality video content for marketing campaigns, advertisements, social media, corporate projects, events, and branded content.

Transform raw footage into polished and engaging videos with strong storytelling and pacing.

 Enhance videos using motion graphics, transitions, animations, sound design, color grading, captions, and visual effects.

 Ensure all video outputs meet brand standards, creative direction, and technical requirements.



 Content Planning & Strategy



 Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to develop video concepts, campaign ideas, and content strategies.

 Plan video content calendars and production schedules aligned with marketing objectives.

 Research industry trends, audience behavior, and competitor content to generate innovative ideas.

 Recommend creative approaches to improve engagement, reach, and overall content performance.



 Creative Leadership



 Provide creative direction and guidance to junior editors, videographers, or content creators when necessary.

 Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute fresh creative concepts.

 Maintain consistency in visual branding, storytelling style, and content quality across all projects.



 Project & Workflow Management



 Manage multiple video projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and quality expectations.

 Coordinate revisions and approvals with internal teams, clients, or stakeholders.

 Organize project assets, editing timelines, and file management efficiently.

 Utilize workflow and collaboration tools such as 
, Notion, Trello, Google Drive, or similar platforms.



 Performance Optimization



 Review video analytics and campaign performance metrics to improve future content strategies.

 Optimize video formats and edits for various platforms and audience preferences.

 Continuously test new creative techniques, formats, and storytelling approaches.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



 Timely delivery of video projects

 Overall quality and creativity of video outputs

 Engagement and performance of published content

 Brand consistency across all video materials

 Efficiency in revision and approval processes

 Audience retention and content effectiveness

 Productivity and project turnaround time



Qualifications & Skills



 Education & Experience



 Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Film, Multimedia Arts, Media Production, Communications, or related field preferred.

 Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in video editing and content planning.

 Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of video editing projects and creative campaigns.

 Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software.



 Skills & Competencies



 Strong storytelling, editing, and visual composition skills.

 Excellent understanding of video production workflows and content strategy.

 Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.

 Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

 Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.

 Knowledge of current digital marketing and social media trends.

 Leadership and mentoring abilities are an advantage.



Other Requirements

Experience in handling both long-form and short-form video content is preferred.

 Ability to adapt to changing creative priorities and tight deadlines.

 Knowledge of photography, videography, or motion graphics is a plus.

 Flexible schedule when needed to support production timelines and campaign launches.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
We are building out the records and document infrastructure of the firm inside DocuWare, our document management system. This role exists to own the indexing layer of that system.



You will be the person who receives, reviews, classifies, indexes, and files every document that moves through the firm. Closing statements. Operating agreements. K-1s. Bank statements. Vendor invoices. Property-level financial reports. Entity formation documents. The full document footprint of a multi-entity, multi-portfolio practice.



YOU WILL:

Receive incoming documents through
, secure file transfers, client portals, and direct downloads

Index documents in DocuWare against our taxonomy — client entity, document type, date, fiscal period, related transaction, and any other metadata required by the file's classification

Apply consistent naming conventions and tagging across every document, every time

Maintain version control on documents that update over time (financial statements, operating agreements, amended returns)

Flag inconsistencies, duplicates, missing pages, or documents that don't fit the existing taxonomy

Track document intake against expected lists — for example, identifying which K-1s, statements, or closing documents are still outstanding for a given engagement

Coordinate with the firm on edge cases and refine the indexing rules as the system matures

Maintain a clean, searchable, audit-ready records environment across every active client

- You will also own the monthly download process across all entities that encompass bank, loan and other monthly statements for all clients and entities.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Credit Analyst to support our lenders in managing the end-to-end mortgage application process. This role requires a professional with a minimum of 3 to 4 years of specific Australian mortgage and lending experience; as such, we are looking for a candidate who can hit the ground running without the need for foundational training. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of a loan, from lead conversion and data entry to credit assessment and post-settlement enquiries. While you will receive initial support, you are expected to take full ownership of your workflow, ensuring all applications meet rigorous credit policies and legislative standards. 



Responsibilities 

Salesforce & LoanApp Management: Managing accurate data entry within Salesforce and overseeing the LoanApp platform to ensure seamless application flows. 

Lead Conversion: Creating leads and converting them into opportunities within the CRM system. 

Application Submission: Submitting completed loan applications to the funder and issuing credit guides where applicable. 

Valuation Management: Ordering and managing valuation reports to ensure property security meets lending criteria. 

Reporting & Title Searches: Generating comprehensive credit reports and completing necessary title searches. 

Progress Draw Management: Overseeing the management of progress draws for construction or staged funding. 

KYC Compliance: Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) verifications using tools such as IDyou or IDkit. 

Documentation & Signatures: Completing all required application forms and coordinating the sending of documents for digital signatures. 

Financial Calculations: Completing funding tables and servicing calculators to determine borrower capacity. 

Credit Proposal Drafting: Drafting detailed credit proposals for formal credit assessment. 

Credit Assessment: Assessing applications prior to submission to the senior credit analyst for final review. 

Policy Compliance: Reviewing credit limits in line with specific internal policies and procedures.

Approval Recommendations: Recommending applications for approval or decline based on risk analysis. 

Underwriter Liaison: Dealing with underwriter Mortgage Information Requests (MIR) and resolving technical queries. 

Outcome Notification: Issuing formal approval or decline letters to relevant parties. 

Settlement Support: Assisting with a wide range of pre-settlement and post-settlement enquiries. 



Requirements 

3–4 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage lending (lender-side experience is essential; broker-side only will not be considered). 

Proven ability to handle the end-to-end loan process with minimal supervision. 

Deep understanding of Australian credit policies and lending benchmarks. 

Advanced analytical, mathematical, and comprehension skills. 

Ability to manage competing deadlines effectively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 

Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies in complex financial data. 

Strong communication skills for interacting with underwriters and internal stakeholders. 



Software Proficiency 

Salesforce (nice to have) 

LoanApp 

IDyou / IDkit 

Credit Reporting Tools (Equifax / Illion) 

Servicing Calculators 

Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related fields. 

Additional certifications in Australian Mortgage Broking or Financial Services are highly desirable. 



Personal Attributes 

Critical thinking – Ability to evaluate applications objectively and identify potential risks. 

Consistent and methodical – A disciplined approach to following processes and procedures. 

Persistence – Dedication to seeing complex applications through to completion and resolving MIRs. 

Team orientated – A collaborative mindset focused on supporting lenders and the wider credit team. 

Love of learning – A desire to stay updated on evolving Australian lending regulations and policies. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

Required

What We Offer

title: Graphic Design & AI Content Specialist
description:
The Modern Freelancer | Fully Remote



The Modern Freelancer is a US-based media group producing content for freelancers. We publish a weekly newsletter, a blog, and social content read by thousands of freelance marketers, and we license our brand and audience to B2B companies whose ideal customer is a freelancer. Leading brands run ads through our whitelisted page so their creative feels native to the audience, not like a brand pitch from a stranger. You can learn more about our B2B media offer at 
/b2b-media.

We're hiring a full-time Graphic Design & AI Content Specialist to own static Meta ad production for our client roster.



The Role



You're a graphic designer first. Figma is your home base. You understand layout, typography, hierarchy, and what makes a static ad stop the scroll on Meta. You also know your way around AI image tools, and you use them to move faster and unlock visuals that would otherwise take a photoshoot and a budget to produce.

You'll work closely with our creative strategist, who delivers briefs, copy and references. You'll turn those into ads that stop the scroll.



Key Responsibilities



Design native-style, performance-driven static Meta ads for our clients (1:1 and 9:16 formats)

Work from creative briefs and turn them into multiple ad variations, fast

Use AI generation tools (Midjourney, nano banana, and whatever else is in your stack) to produce assets that would otherwise require custom photography

Adapt brand assets into ads that feel native to the feed, not polished to death

Sit in on weekly performance reviews so you see what's winning and what's losing, and adjust your output accordingly

Flag your own creative ideas. If you spot an idea the brief missed, you say so.



Required Skills & Experience



Strong graphic design fundamentals with Figma as your primary tool

Daily fluency with AI image tools (Midjourney, nano banana, DALL·E, or equivalents) used to support real client work, not just experiments

Strong understanding of branding, layout, typography, and visual storytelling

Experience designing for social media and paid digital campaigns, especially Meta

Excellent file organization and communication habits (you can juggle multiple clients without anything slipping)



What We're Looking For



Three things, in this order.

1. A designer who understands aesthetics AND performance. Pretty doesn't equal effective. You know that a 3 second scroll-stop matters more than a perfect grid. You can defend your design choices with reasoning, not vibes.

2. AI fluency, not AI obsession. AI is part of your toolkit, not your whole identity. You reach for Midjourney when it's the right tool, and you reach for Figma when it's the right tool. You're not trying to AI-generate everything.

3. A self-starter who owns their work. You don't need a tight brief for every output. You ask sharp questions when something's unclear and fill in the blanks with judgment when it's not.



What We Offer



Full-time role with real ownership of the creative output

Premium B2B clients spending $30K to $100K+ per month on Meta ads

Direct mentorship from a team who's run hundreds of millions in Meta ad spend

Creative freedom and a fast-moving environment

Clear growth path as the agency scales

Competitive salary based on experience



How to Apply



Share your portfolio of static ad work (Meta ads preferred), with at least 2 examples where AI tools played a role in the final asset

A 60 second Loom on why this role fits

Include "Popcorn" in your subject line



Shortlisted candidates will receive a test project as the next step before an offer.



Work Location: Fully Remote

title: Paralegal
description:
Company: Suits Finance

Work Arrangement: Remote (Full-time)

Compensation: Market-conform salary

Availability: Immediate





About Suits Finance



Suits Finance is a dynamic financial services firm providing data-driven and cross-border solutions for global entrepreneurs, corporate entities, and e-commerce businesses. We specialize in resolving complex financial and compliance-related challenges across multiple jurisdictions, including banking, corporate structuring, and regulatory coordination.



As part of our expansion, we are seeking a Paralegal / Banking Compliance & Funds Release Specialist with strong experience in handling cases involving frozen, held, or restricted corporate bank accounts, particularly in the United States, United Kingdon, European Union, Hong Kong, and other major jurisdictions.





Position Overview



As a Paralegal / Funds Release Specialist at Suits Finance, you will play a critical role in assisting clients whose company bank accounts or funds have been frozen, held, or restricted by financial institutions or payment service providers.



You will work closely with bank representatives, compliance teams, and internal stakeholders to prepare documentation, draft formal correspondence, and support account remediation and funds release processes. This role requires a strong understanding of banking procedures, compliance requirements, and legal documentation related to corporate accounts.





Key Responsibilities



Funds Release & Banking Compliance Support

- Handle cases involving frozen, held, or restricted corporate bank accounts and funds.

- Assist in preparing and organizing documentation required by banks and financial institutions for account remediation and fund release.

- Coordinate with bank compliance teams, payment processors, and third-party institutions to support resolution processes.

- Track case progress, deadlines, and compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions (US, UK, EU, HK).



Legal & Paralegal Functions

- Draft formal letters, affidavits, declarations, and explanations required for banking compliance reviews.

- Review and organize corporate documents (Articles of Incorporation, Operating Agreements, Shareholder Registers, KYC documents, etc.).

- Support legal research related to banking regulations, compliance requirements, and account restrictions.

- Maintain accurate records of case files, correspondence, and supporting documents.



Client Communication & Case Management

- Communicate professionally with clients to gather information and explain required steps for fund release.

- Provide clear updates on case status, requirements, and next actions.

- Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure cases are handled efficiently and accurately.





Qualifications & Requirements

- Proven experience as a Paralegal, Legal Assistant, or Banking Compliance Specialist.

- Strong familiarity with cases involving frozen or held corporate bank accounts and funds.

- Knowledge of banking compliance procedures, KYC/AML requirements, and corporate documentation.

- Experience working with banks, payment processors, or financial institutions is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for formal and client-facing correspondence.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple cases simultaneously.

- Experience with cross-border clients or international corporate structures is preferred.





Why Join Suits Finance?

- Be part of a globally connected and professional team.

- Gain hands-on exposure to complex banking compliance and funds release cases.

- Enjoy a 100% remote work setup with flexible hours and supportive management.

- Work on high-impact cases that directly help clients regain access to their funds.

- Be valued for your precision, legal insight, and problem-solving skills.





Application Process



Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter highlighting their paralegal, banking compliance, or funds release experience.



We strictly do not accept applications via
. Please submit your application only through this platform.

title: Executive Assistant to US Startup Founder — Long-term, $1,300–$1,500/m
description:
We're hiring a long-term Executive Assistant to support the founder and CEO of a US-based startup in consumer wellness and longevity. This is full-time and remote.



Some context



The CEO thinks faster than he can act, generates more ideas than he can execute, and is easily pulled in many directions at once. The right person for this role isn't someone who just executes tasks — you function as an external operating system. You build the structure he can't. You hold the context he forgets. You protect the focus he needs to do his best work.



If you've supported a founder or entrepreneur before — especially one who's visionary but somewhat disorganized, where every day brings new priorities — you'll recognize the work. If you've only supported corporate executives in very structured environments, this will likely be a difficult fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own his calendar — block focus time, protect deep work, decline meetings that shouldn't happen

- Triage his inbox — d
 what needs response, draft replies in his voice, clear noise

- Track every commitment he makes to others, and chase them down before they slip

- Build systems he won't build himself (weekly reviews, project trackers, SOPs)

- Handle travel, logistics, vendor communication, personal admin

- Handle special projects (research, vendor vetting, etc)

- Be the bridge between him and his team, partners, and clients



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE



You'll thrive here if:



- You'd rather have ten priorities than one, and you have a system for keeping them all moving

- When something is unclear, your instinct is to make a decision and bring it forward — not wait for direction

- You're comfortable disagreeing with your boss in private and committing in public

- You like building processes from scratch and refining them every week

- You're calm when plans change at 7pm for tomorrow morning

- You take it personally (in a good way) when something on your watch slips



And here's what you get for it:



- A real seat at the table. You'll have visibility into every part of the businesses — strategy, partnerships, finances, the decisions being made in the room. Not just the calendar.

- A founder who teaches. Once you've earned trust, the CEO is generous with context, time, and judgment. The right person here will learn more in 12 months than in five years at most companies.

- Genuine ownership. You'll be measured on outcomes, not hours. Things you build will stay built. 

- A clear growth path.

- Exposure to multiple businesses. You'll touch consumer wellness, longevity science, and others. Few EAs get this kind of range in a single role.

- A long-term partnership. Your job is to embed deeply, not to churn through tasks. We invest in the relationship — fair pay, 13th-month bonus, paid time off when you need it, weekly pay for the first two months so you never feel exposed.



WHO WILL NOT SUCCEED



Please save us both the time and don't apply if any of the following describes you. There is no judgment in this list — these traits work great in other roles, just not this one.



- You want a clearly defined job description. This role changes weekly. Some days are calendar and inbox. Other days are project management, research, vendor calls, or personal logistics. If you need a fixed scope to feel comfortable, you'll be unhappy here.

- You wait to be told what to do. If your past managers had to ask "did you do X yet?", this isn't the right fit. We need someone who notices what needs doing before being asked.

- You're conflict-averse with executives. You'll need to tell the CEO "no, you can't take that meeting" and "you said you'd do this and you haven't." If pushing back on someone senior feels impossible, this role will break you.

- You need consistent routines and predictable days. Priorities shift regularly. A "quiet week" can turn into a busy week by Tuesday. If you need perfect stability to function, you'll burn out.

- You're looking for 9-to-5 with hard boundaries. Most weeks are normal. Some have a 7am request or a Saturday emergency. We pay fairly and we don't abuse it, but if rigid hours are non-negotiable, this isn't the role.

- You want to specialize. If you only want to do calendar, or only want to write, or only want to handle social, you'll be frustrated. This is a generalist role.

- You can't fully commit to one role. No side hustles you're protecting. No second client. We pay full-time so we get full-time.

- You need a lot of positive feedback to feel okay. The CEO is warm but moves fast. Praise is real but inconsistent. If you need regular validation, you'll feel out of place.



If you read those two lists and felt energized by the first and uncomfortable about the second — apply. If the second list felt more like you, please save your time. We genuinely appreciate the self-awareness.



REQUIREMENTS



- 3+ years EA or chief-of-staff experience, ideally for a founder or entrepreneur

- Excellent written and verbal English. Must be fluent

- Strong project management instincts — you naturally turn chaos into checklists

- Tech-fluent: Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, project management tools, basic automation (Zapier or Make).

- AI fluent: comfortable using a variety of tools to make your work better and more efficient

- Proactive by default — you bring options, not just questions



COMPENSATION AND TERMS



- $1,300 – $1,500 USD/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Significant overlap with US Pacific time required. You will work US hours.

- Eligible for a bonus at the end of the year.

- Paid time off and US holidays

- Long-term role — we are not looking for someone for 3 months



TO APPLY



Send the following to 



1. A short written response (max 500 words): describe a time you supported a leader who was disorganized or frequently changing priorities. What did you do and how did you handle the situation? What worked? What didn't? End your written response with the word "drew35" as the final word.



2. A 3-minute video answering: why are you the right person for this role, what interests you about the job, and how would you structure the first 30 days on the job?



3. Your resume with links to any systems or work samples like dashboard or project management tools you've built (screenshots are fine).



Applications missing any of these three items, or missing the code word "drew35" at the end of the written response, will not be reviewed.

title: Real Estate Market & Licensing Research Specialist
description:
Company Overview:

We are a service based company seeking a highly analytical and detail oriented Real Estate Market & Licensing Research Specialist to support our investment and development initiatives. This role is ideal for someone passionate about real estate, market analysis, and helping identify profitable opportunities for investment and growth





Position Overview:

This position focuses on conducting thorough research on real estate markets, property rehabilitation opportunities, and state-specific licensing requirements for certain programs. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, great with numbers, experienced with the BRRRR Method (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat), understands basic construction pricing and workflow processes, evaluates auction properties, demonstrates out-of-the-box thinking, and is capable of performing in-depth research on programs such as Article 28 and Article 31, compiling step-by-step guides for licensing and approvals. The role requires strong follow-through to ensure all aspects of a project are completed from research to execution







Key Responsibilities:



Conduct detailed real estate market research to identify the best-performing and emerging markets for investment



Provide comprehensive market analysis reports, including metrics such as average home prices, rental rates, property values, and local market trends



Research rehab (renovation) opportunities in targeted markets and estimate potential costs, returns, and project feasibility



Understand basic construction pricing, set up, and workflow processes to better evaluate rehab projects



Evaluate auction properties, identifying promising deals and assessing potential risks and returns



Prepare clear and organized Excel reports summarizing findings, including property data, rehab budgets, auction analysis, and deal breakdowns for management review



Perform state-by-state research on rules and procedures for obtaining licenses or approvals required to run certain programs (e.g., Article 28, Article 31, etc.)



Compile step-by-step guides detailing how to file and obtain necessary licenses or program approvals in each state



Present research findings and recommendations in a clear and concise format, using innovative approaches to problem-solving



 Follow through on all aspects of projects from initial research to final execution, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and actionable outcomes  

On-site engagement  from A-Z







Requirements;



Experience in real estate research, data analysis, or investment support



Strong understanding of market evaluation, property trends, and basic rehab cost analysis



Knowledge of basic construction pricing and workflow processes



Experience evaluating real estate auctions and identifying profitable opportunities



Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel (formulas, data organization, and presentation)



Proven ability to conduct independent, detailed research and summarize findings effectively



Excellent written and verbal communication skills



Strategic, detail-oriented, and solution-focused mindset



Demonstrated out-of-the-box thinking to find creative solutions and uncover unique opportunities



Great with numbers and experienced with the BRRRR Method



Fluent in American English (spoken and written)









Position Details:



Type: Full-time



Schedule: Monday to Friday



Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (1-hour lunch break)

etings and check-ins

title: AI Video Editor / Content Producer
description:
We're a crypto mining operation — ASIC sales, hosting, repairs, and full mining infrastructure for clients across MENA, North America, LatAm, and Asia. We sell hardware that costs $1,500 to $10,000 a unit, in volumes of 10 to 500 at a time. Our buyers are serious — HNWIs, family offices, hosting clients, miner resellers. They don't buy from companies that look amateur. Content is how we build trust at scale.

We're hiring one operator to own video and motion across all our channels — short-form social, facility tours, ASIC product content, motion graphics explainers, paid ad creative. This is a daily-output role for someone fluent in modern editing and AI video tooling.

The Role

You're the engine. We feed you raw footage from the facility, product shots, voice memos, scripts, market data, and trends — you turn them into 5–10 finished assets per week. Vertical short-form, motion graphics, product demos, facility tours, mining education content, paid ads. You don't wait for direction once you understand the brand. You batch, you ship, you iterate.

This isn't a "one polished video a week" role. Mining moves fast — halvings, hashprice swings, new ASICs, hosting deals. If you need three rounds of feedback per piece, you'll hate this job.

What You'll Do



Produce 5–10 finished short-form videos per week for TikTok, Reels, X, and YouTube Shorts

Build 2–4 motion graphics explainers per month — hashrate visualizations, profitability breakdowns, hosting economics, ASIC comparisons

Edit facility tour and ASIC product content — clean B-roll, color, audio, captions, on-screen specs

Cut founder content and long-form — podcast clips, full facility walkthroughs, customer testimonials, workshop recordings (1–2 per week)

Generate AI video and image assets using Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Sora, Runway, Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana when live footage isn't enough

Produce paid ad creative for Meta, X, YouTube — 5–10 variants per campaign, A/B-ready

Design thumbnails, cover frames, and looping post variants

Write captions, hooks, and on-screen copy that speak crypto-native — no corporate filler

Maintain a clean asset library (B-roll, ASIC product shots, music, SFX, brand kit)

Stay current with new AI video tools — we test new models within a week of release



Required Tools (you're fluent in all of these)



Editing: CapCut Pro (desktop + mobile), Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

Motion graphics: Adobe After Effects (intermediate minimum — kinetic typography, masks, expressions, basic 3D camera work)

AI video: Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Veo, Sora — at least 3 of these on a daily basis

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Recraft

AI voice & audio: ElevenLabs, Suno

Design: Figma (thumbnails, brand assets), Photoshop (light retouching)

Workflow: 
 or Google Drive for review, Notion or ClickUp for task tracking



You're a Fit If You



Have 2+ years producing short-form content for brands, creators, or agencies

Have a public portfolio or reel — Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or Behance — that proves it

Can edit a 30-second vertical from raw clips in under 2 hours

Have actually shipped content using AI video tools, not just experimented

Understand pacing, hooks, retention curves, and why the first 1.5 seconds is everything

Live in crypto. You hold it, you follow mining
, you can pronounce "hashrate" without hesitation. You know the difference between an S21 and an M60. You don't need a glossary.

Write decent English captions and on-screen copy. Native is a plus but not required.

Are reliable on Slack/Telegram during overlapping hours with 
 working time (GMT+4, 9am–6pm)

Can work weekends occasionally during launches or trade shows — always announced in advance

Own a machine that can handle 4K editing without crashing (M1 Pro / RTX 3060 minimum)



Bonus Points



You've already produced content for a crypto, mining, or fintech brand

You can do basic 3D (Blender, Spline, or Cinema 4D) — useful for ASIC product renders and facility visualizations

You've run a crypto-adjacent account of your own

You understand mining economics well enough to write the script, not just edit it

You've used n8n, Make, or Zapier to automate parts of your own workflow



Auto-Disqualifies



Wedding videographer pivoting in — different muscle entirely

"I use ChatGPT for captions" as a value prop — table stakes, not a skill

"I'm new to crypto but I'll learn" — not for this role. Buyers can smell tourists in the captions.

Need brief approvals for every asset — we work in batches and trust you



Compensation



Base: $1,500/month for full-time (40 hrs/week)

+ $100 bonus per video that crosses 100K views on any platform

+ $500 monthly bonus if all weekly output targets hit

+ Performance bonus tied to ad creative that drives qualified leads — we track attribution

Performance review every 90 days with a base raise to $2,000–$2,500/mo for proven operators

Paid in USDC or USD — your call. Weekly or monthly — your call.

14 days paid time off per year + UAE public holidays observed



Realistic Year 1 total comp for a strong operator: $22,000–$32,000.

How to Apply

Send the following to the contact below:



A 60-second reel of your best work — short-form vertical, motion graphics, or AI-video edits. No wedding montages.

A Loom (3 minutes max) answering:



What AI video tools do you use weekly, and what's your current favorite?

Show me one piece of content where you owned the entire pipeline (idea ? script ? edit ? ship), and walk me through your process.

Pitch me one piece of content you'd shoot/edit this week for a crypto mining company. Format, hook, angle, target platform.





Links to 3 social accounts you've produced content for (yours or clients'). Direct profile or video links. No private folders.



Subject line: Mining Content — [Your Name] — [Years of Experience]

Example: Mining Content — Maria Santos — 4 years

Applications without all three components or with a generic subject line get auto-deleted. We respect your time — please respect ours.

We reply within 5 business days. If you crush the initial review, the next step is a paid test task: produce one 30-second vertical edit and one 15-second motion graphic from raw assets we provide. Paid $100 on completion regardless of hire decision.
